provenance: Machine twin of the Online Channel & Capability Registry (01-model-company/channel-capability-registry.md) for the man-hours roll-up (07-methodology/manhours-rollup.py): every registry row at a DISABLED state lists the workflows/process areas/value streams whose ENTIRE effort is dormant (frozen as designed capacity, excluded from live totals). Curated, not parsed — a Vehicles cell may cite support flows or mixed live/dormant estates that must NOT be marked (see exclusions). Updated in the same change as any registry row flip (W5580; registry rule 4). The sourcing_register_deferrals section is the second half of the twin: the capability-sourcing register §4's 'squad deferred — prepared' amendments hold entire value-stream estates at designed capacity exactly as the registry's DISABLED — rows do, but they are sourcing-register rows (W5515's register), not registry rows — so their dormant sets live here under the same discipline (updated in the same change as any §4 posture flip; the roll-up folds them into the dormant classification and validate-repo.sh Check 83 re-derives the registry↔register and sourcing-seam mirrors every run). Found by the 2026-09-25 (bt) ninth review-everything pass: VS-60/VS-74/VS-77 carried the guarded 'held at designed capacity' banners while the roll-up priced them live.
attribution_note: A workflow mapped to several capabilities (e.g. W829 under CAP-F04 and CAP-F09) counts once in the live/dormant headline totals and in each capability's own row.

exclusions.PA-75.2 / PA-75.3 partial: CAP-C02 is the customer mobile storefront — the in-store digital estate (W2654–W2656 kiosks/QR/self-checkout, W2658 digital receipts, W2660 Wi-Fi, W2661 ESL), the associate app (W2659) and the cross-channel digital analytics (W2662, W2664, W2666–W2669) stay live; only the app-specific W2646–W2653, W5553, W2657, W2663, W2665 are dormant
exclusions.W3322: PA-102.3 sales commission & trade-incentive plan design — a live HR workflow whose trade-incentive slice is dormant (CAP-B03); the workflow itself stays live, so it is not marked
exclusions.W1549: covered by PA-11.2 tree dormancy (CAP-B01); listed here only as a cross-reference
exclusions.PA-11.3: wholesale operations — not a (x)-direction vehicle (CAP-B01 names PA-11.1/PA-11.2 only); stays live
exclusions.PA-16.1/PA-16.2/PA-16.3: CAP-B02's 'AR & Credit (VS-16.3)' citation is ambiguous and the PA-16 estate serves retail (consumer credit scoring, installments, payment settlement); stays live pending explicit direction

sourcing_register_deferrals.provenance: Capability-sourcing register §4 (07-methodology/capability-sourcing-and-engineering-model.md) rows whose posture cell reads 'Build — squad deferred — prepared': the sourcing-side dormant estates. Distinct from the registry rows above in trigger only — a deferral re-activates on its sourcing-row stand-up trigger (W5580 carries the state change either way) — and identical in man-hours treatment: designed capacity, never live load. The exempt_value_streams lists are the adjudicated seams (e.g. the (ad) consumer-side bulky ruling): a VS exempted there stays live and must not be bannered dormant (audit-model-docs' tps_project_estate_hits protects the VS-143 seam).
